data.description: Situated in the middle of Al Khail Road and Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Jumeirah Village Triangle is a gated family-friendly neighbourhood. This freehold community has been developed by Nakheel Properties and home a plethora of residential options.

data.answer: Jumeirah Village Triangle is the epitome of comfort and convenience when it comes to a vibrant lifestyle. The area is home to many housing options as well as open green spaces. There are gardens and parks as well as fitness facilities. The area is home to retail outlets as well as sporting arenas. Properties in Jumeirah Village Triangle have been divided into 9 different communities, all of which come together to form a triangle.

Properties in Jumeirah Village Triangle offer a vast variety of options to choose from. You can choose to live in villas in Jumeirah Village Triangle or townhouses in Jumeirah Village Triangle. There are over 5000 options available. You can choose from 1 – 2 bedroom townhouses or villas with 1 – 5 bedrooms. Most of them have been constructed with an Arabian or Mediterranean design aesthetic. It is perfect for small families and individuals. You can also live in apartments in Jumeirah Village Triangle and have a choice of 1, 2, 3 bedroom options.

Located close to Dubai Production City, Jumeirah Village Triangle is very close to Jumeirah Village Circle and The Springs as well. It is a short drive from Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai. The closest metro station is the Damac Properties metro station which is just a few minutes’ drive from the community.

  • 08 mins – Dubai Sports City
  • 12 mins – Dubai Production City
  • 13 mins – Jumeirah Village Circle
  • 15 mins – Dubai Marina | JLT | JBR
  • 19 mins – Palm Jumeirah
  • 28 mins – Dubai International Airport

Shopping in Jumeirah Village Triangle

Residents can get their grocery shopping done in the local shops within the community. There are quite a few shops dotted around in Jumeirah Village Triangle. There are more in the neighbourhoods around, like JVC. Residents can access the Spinneys close by as well. The closest mall to Jumeirah Village Triangle is the community mall, Al Khail Avenue. City Centre Me’aisem is also nearby. The Mall of Emirates is a short drive from Jumeirah Village Triangle.

Restaurants Nearby

Jumeirah Village Triangle is home to many popular restaurants within the community. The malls close by are home to a plethora of dining options, from fast food, casual to even fine-dining options.

Beach Access from Jumeirah Village Triangle

The closest beach to Jumeirah Village Triangle is the JBR Beach. It is a short drive from the neighbourhood.

Amenities for fitness enthusiasts

Jumeirah Village Triangle is home to a plethora of fitness facilities. Residents can benefit from the pitches for football and cricket, sports arena, tennis courts, tracks for cycling and jogging as well as swimming pools. The community is spotted with beautiful areas for residents to enjoy and relax. Kids can enjoy at the Jumeirah Village Triangle Community Park as well.

Schools & Clinics

Jumeirah Village Triangle is an ideal place to live if you have children. The community is close to many nurseries, schools and daycare centres. The Jumeirah International Nursery, Sunmarke School and Arcadia Preparatory School are all located within the vicinity of Jumeirah Village Triangle. The students looking for higher education options can enrol at accredited universities in Dubai Knowledge Park, which is a short drive from Jumeirah Village Triangle.

Jumeirah Village Triangle is located close to NMC Royal Hospital, Saudi German Hospital and Al Zahra Hospital, all within a short distance from the neighbourhood.

Own properties in Jumeirah Village Triangle and live a vibrant community lifestyle with your family.

data.content:
Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) in Dubai, Situated in the middle of Al Khail Road and Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offers over 5,000 residential units including villas, townhouses, and apartments. This community is known for its small villas and townhouses with spacious gardens, and is divided into nine districts.

Key amenities include landscaped gardens, parks, tennis and basketball courts. It's well-connected, being at the junction of Sheikh Zayed highway and Al Khail Road, and is close to various landmarks and essential services. 

JVT houses educational institutions like Sunmarke School and Arcadia School, and is near several nurseries. Healthcare facilities are conveniently located, with Mediclinic Springs being the closest. While JVT is a family-friendly community with diverse property options, it's still under construction in parts.

nodes.title: Binghatti Luxuria
nodes.about:
Binghatti Luxuria JVT is a contemporary residential development by Binghatti Holding, located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle. The project features a carefully structured mix of studios, one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments, and exclusive two-bedroom Royal Suites, each designed with efficiency, privacy, and comfort in mind.

Rising across 24 residential floors, the tower blends modernist architecture with refined interiors and thoughtfully planned layouts. Retail spaces at ground level and a dedicated lifestyle podium further enhance daily convenience. With competitive entry prices and a balanced unit mix, Binghatti Luxuria appeals to both end-users and investors seeking value within a well-connected Dubai community.

nodes.title: Seslia Tower
nodes.about:
Seslia Tower - a luxury project by developer Tiger Group, located in JVT. The complex is a 36-storey tower designed in a modern style. The main feature of the unique facades are glass panels and clear lines of balconies.

All residences of the complex have unique layouts designed to provide residents with maximum comfort and convenience. High-quality materials are used in the interior decoration, which harmoniously combine with each other and create a cosy atmosphere.

Among the exclusive amenities of the complex, residents will find a swimming pool, a gym with modern equipment, a children's playground and many recreational areas with barbecue facilities. The complex has 24-hour security and car parking. There are cafes and restaurants, retail outlets, kindergartens and schools within walking distance.

The area is located near the main motorway of Dubai - Sheikh Zayed Road, thanks to which residents will be able to get to the objects of social and entertainment infrastructure of the city. JBR Beach and Palm Jumeirah are 20 minutes away by car, the Mall Of Emirates shopping centre is 15 minutes away and Downtown, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 25 minutes away.

nodes.title: SkyGate Tower
nodes.about:
SkyGate Tower at Jumeirah Village Triangle is a 46-storey residential tower by Tiger Group. It offers a choice of studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3 and 4-bedroom duplexes. 

All homes are fully furnished, making them ideal for those looking for a move-in-ready property in a central Dubai location.

Sky Gate Tower by Tiger Group combines modern design, high-quality finishes, and excellent community facilities. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, a fitness center, green atriums, and peaceful relaxation areas. 

With flexible post-handover payment plans and promising ROI potential, the project appeals to both investors and end-users who value comfort, convenience, and long-term growth.

nodes.title: Interstellar Tower
nodes.about:
Interstellar Tower is a visionary mixed-use development by Mr. Eight Development, located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT). The project blends contemporary design, mindful luxury, and community-focused living within Dubai’s most family-friendly neighbourhood. Properties include 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, exclusive garden homes, premium offices, and retail spaces — all thoughtfully designed to meet diverse lifestyle and business needs.

A true destination, Interstellar Tower elevates living with outstanding features such as swimming pools, a fitness centre, a rooftop park with a flowing river, and an open-air rooftop cinema. With branded residences, curated retail, and a full spectrum of amenities, Interstellar by Mr. Eight Development sets new standards of sustainable luxury and high-return investment opportunities in Dubai. Residents and business owners alike can enjoy the vibrant lifestyle created by the Interstellar Tower at JVT amenities.

nodes.title: Binghatti Flare
nodes.about:
Rising in the heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), Binghatti Flare is a dynamic residential project by renowned developer Binghatti. Comprising two elegant towers, the development offers thoughtfully designed studio and 1-bedroom apartments, blending modern architecture with practical living. Residents can enjoy a host of lifestyle features including a swimming pool, fitness center, and children’s play area.

Binghatti Flare at JVT Dubai is designed to appeal to residents seeking both comfort and investment potential. From its strategic location to its curated lifestyle amenities, the project stands out for its quality and design. Binghatti’s reputation as a visionary developer, along with high rental yield potential in JVT, positions this development as a smart choice for investors and homeowners alike.

nodes.title: Fashionz
nodes.about:
Fashionz - a luxury residential development by Danube Properties, located in the dynamic and fast developing neighborhood of JVT. Fashionz, designed to cater to the sophisticated lifestyle of fashion lovers, offers a unique living experience combining elegance, style and convenience.

Situated in a prime location, Fashionz provides residents with easy access to the city's vibrant fashion scene, designer boutiques, high-end shopping malls and fashion events. The thoughtfully designed residences reflect a contemporary and fashionable aesthetic, incorporating sleek finishes, modern amenities and spacious living spaces.

Fashionz offers 1-3 bedroom apartments and exclusive Presidential Suites, each carefully designed to provide a luxurious living experience. The apartments are designed with the highest quality materials, stylish interiors and panoramic views of the cityscape.

Fashionz residents can enjoy a host of exclusive amenities to enhance their quality of life. These include state-of-the-art fitness centers, swimming pools, spas, landscaped gardens, concierge services and 24-hour security. The complex may also include community spaces and social areas where residents can socialize and socialize.

Fashionz offers a luxurious and trendy atmosphere that combines style, comfort and convenience for those who appreciate the finer things in life.
